ete-monorepo:.name: Test Workspace Config
ete-monorepo:.summary:
A workspace configuration layer, it tells the test runner how to assemble projects. It exists to organize test execution rather than implement product logic.

Provides vitest.workspace.ts at the repository root.

Runs at test tool startup.

Vitest reads it to discover workspace projects.

@ete/core:.name: Core Tests
@ete/core:.summary:
A unit test area, which contains assertions that check behavior in the core package.

Holds packages/core/test/schema.test.ts, a schema focused test file under packages/core.

runs under the test runner.

Runs within Vitest, alongside the workspace config from g0.
@ete/core:.role: Handles schema verification for the core package.

folder:packages/core.name: Core Tests
folder:packages/core.summary:
A shared domain library for test plans, recorded steps, observations, and reports. It also contains parsing, caching, and timeline related helpers used by the rest of the repo.

Defines TargetSchema, Step, RawTestFile, parseTestFile, Observation, Anomaly, StepReport, Report, emptyResolved, hashStep, and loadResolved.

Pure library with no runtime of its own.

Used by the CLI and browser driver packages, and exercised by core tests.
folder:packages/core.role: Defines shared test run models and helpers.

ete-monorepo:fixtures.name: Demo Fixture Server
ete-monorepo:fixtures.summary:
A fixture service, it stands in for an application under test. Fixtures like this let browser and core tests point at a stable target without depending on a real deployment.

Exports createDemoServer, root, and types from fixtures/demo-app/server.mjs.

Runs when imported by tests.

Browser tests and core tests use it as their target app.
ete-monorepo:fixtures.role: Serves a demo application for integration tests.

@ete/driver-browser:src @ete/driver-brow.name: Browser Automation Driver
@ete/driver-browser:src @ete/driver-brow.summary:
A browser automation driver package with telemetry and filmstrip support. It wraps browser interaction primitives and exposes sampled screenshot frames for reporting.

Defines BrowserDriver, BrowserDriver.start, beginStep, observe, locate, act, check, screenshot, stop, and sampleFrames.

Library code used at runtime by callers.

Builds on the core library and is used by the CLI session and command layers, plus browser tests.
@ete/driver-browser:src @ete/driver-brow.role: Handles browser automation and frame sampling.

ete:.name: CLI Tests
ete:.summary:
A test component is a collection of verification code that exercises another part of the system from the outside. This one only contains CLI test files and a port helper, so it is about checking the command line area rather than shipping the command line itself.

Holds packages/cli/test/app.test.ts and config.test.ts, with the freePort helper used by those tests.

Test code that runs under the test runner.

Uses the CLI test files and the freePort helper; stands alone.

folder:packages/cli.name: CLI Tests
folder:packages/cli.summary:
A command line entrypoint and configuration layer. It contains the program bootstrap plus helpers for reading config and starting the app.

Defines program, session, cwd, out, AppHandle, waitForUrl, startApp, ConfigSchema, Config, parseConfig, and loadConfig.

Runs as the command line entrypoint.

Calls the CLI commands layer, and the CLI tests drive it.
folder:packages/cli.role: Handles command startup and config resolution.

ete:src ete:test.name: CLI Tests
ete:src ete:test.summary:
A command line support area, combining startup control with configuration parsing for the CLI package.

Provides the app handle and startup helpers alongside config schema, parsing, and loading utilities.

Runs at test time and as a process helper.

The app controller uses the config parser, and the CLI tests exercise both.
ete:src ete:test.role: Handles app startup and config loading.

ete:src ete:src/commands ete:test.name: CLI Tests
ete:src ete:src/commands ete:test.summary:
A command line entry layer that prepares runtime configuration and exposes user facing commands. It sits above the core runner and browser driver and translates process inputs into library calls.

Provides model creation, lazy resolver setup, app lifecycle helpers, config loading, the command program, and the run and report command implementations.

Runs as a CLI process.

Calls the core library for parsing and running tests, and uses the browser driver when commands need automation.
ete:src ete:src/commands ete:test.role: Handles command line config and commands.
